status: Architecture review only. No challenge execution, repo edits, live/paid calls, commits, or deployment.
minimum_contract_invariants: Raw scope spans are sufficient if local scanning owns mention identity, category, approved metadata value, and ordering.
Version and exact original query binding; finite integer UTF-16 offsets; exact source slices; nonoverlapping complete token coverage; no multiword metadata mention split between scopes.
Every recognized data mention belongs to a requested, excluded, or unresolved data disposition. Context/knowledge cannot silently conceal recognized data.
Negative operator reference is exact and bounded; span validity proves cited text only and cannot prove semantic attachment.
Preserve source positions and clause boundaries in projections; concatenating affirmative fragments can invent pairings or geography contexts.
Metadata normalization and source ordering remain local. Do not accept model category/code fields as authority.
Unsupported pair-scoped or per-clause constraints must block for clarification while retaining established requested fields.
Malformed/old/missing browser evidence follows explicit safe reparse/clarification; derived browser fields never override raw evidence.
Evidence-based intentional empty arrays/nulls must remain empty through structured routing; distinguish them from absent evidence.
New unresolved/invalid evidence flags must feed the existing candidate-pipeline clarification gate.
Direct exclusion checks may veto only locally supported unambiguous patterns; unsupported grammar clarifies. Span/metadata validation does not establish semantic correctness.

reasons: frequency cannot select excluded raw frequency
Raw rescans can resurrect excluded/unresolved geography/concept/sector/frequency
Authoritative evidence must bypass raw scan fallback where empty intentionally
Preserve geography context and pair ordering
appendIntentParams must serialize exact source evidence for search/selection flows
Read-only review of parseSubmittedIntent compatibility and 12000-byte JSON payload ceiling; no endpoint redesign required

existing_policy_adjudications.observation: Frozen metadata-only expectation treats bare Georgia as unresolved. Current architecture deliberately defaults bare Georgia to US state unless country/foreign-country context exists. Parent should classify this case as a requirements-policy dispute if preserving existing default is intended, not silently amend the frozen expectation.
Existing retrieval constructs geography x concept pairs under one frequency. This case calls for safe clarification rather than expanding retrieval scope.

pitfalls: A complete source partition can still be semantically wrong or hide material content under context; independent meaning tests remain essential.
Passing synthetic valid-contract tests proves the validator can carry intended model output, not that the live model reliably produces that output.

Exclusions of frequency/geography/pairs are not all represented by the existing type/value global exclusions. Preserve via explicit filtering or clarification rather than inventing retrieval behavior.
The browser payload parser rejects JSON over 12000 characters and then uses legacy fields. New evidence must remain within this boundary or fail clearly to conservative clarification.
Do not automatically resubmit model-corrected text as the new evidence source; raw text offsets and exact original query must survive unchanged.
